## Source: amazon-inspector (b875dd11198fbfc694fe8b3227090e95f13734b5cf64556c6c727b48d7471035)
The SDK's captureSnapshot() iterated Object.entries(process.env) and attached environment variables to captured errors. Separately, init() invoked syncInfrastructure() using eval("require") to read package.json dependencies. 

## Remediation & Fix Notice (v2.3.0+):
All reported behaviors were completely remediated and refactored in v2.3.0+. All vulnerable versions (0.1.0 through 2.1.0) have been deprecated on npm.
- eval('require') usage removed and replaced with standard module.createRequire().
- Unrestricted process.env collection removed and replaced with an explicit user-configured allowedEnvVars allowlist (default empty).
- Dependency telemetry removed from default behavior and made explicit opt-in.
- Package migrated to canonical scoped package `@deployowl/deployowl`.

cwes.description: The product contained code that appeared to be malicious in nature in versions <= 2.1.0 (Fixed in 2.3.0+).
